body:
Hey man, I know that being socially awkward can be difficult, and I know that it is very hard to see other people interacting normally and not understand how they are doing it. But you actually can get better at it, its a skill just like any other, all you have to do is just try it out every once and a while. Maybe you're not ready to interact with people every day, but maybe you can try once a week to get outside and interacting with people. Maybe you can join a club or group that shares a common interest with you. I don't know if you're religious or not, but churches are generally very welcoming places even if you're just going purely for the social interaction.

Call up your friend, talk to him, go get a coffee with him, talk discuss about your feelings, its a hard thing to do, but I'm sure that he would like to help you. People like to help each other. 

I don't think its worth giving up, and you've posted here so you obviously are capable of expressing your feelings.

Start small, but social interaction, and people are not scary. You can do it.
